purpose: Bind repository development waves, center operators, living metabolisms, Rooms, lenses, tests, outputs and commit crystallization into one center-out composition without replacing their canonical owners.
rule: Pair what already exists before inventing another structure. One concept may appear in many views, but ownership, evidence class, center distance and foundation state stay explicit.

development_waves.label: Ownership foundation
development_waves.meaning: Rooms, holdings, data bundles and dossiers establish one-owner knowledge custody before navigation.

development_waves.label: Spatial House
development_waves.meaning: Heaven/World/Below, compass and governed population make the House spatially explorable.

development_waves.label: Living routes
development_waves.meaning: Tree/plane and Seed/Spiral contracts turn static symbols into routed growth, Strife, repair and return.

development_waves.label: Typed comparative expansion
development_waves.meaning: Navigation authority, terrain/regime grammar and placement rules populate outward mirrors while preserving source traditions and type boundaries.

development_waves.label: Center refocus
development_waves.meaning: Potato of Life becomes semantic center; Axis remains spatial center; comparative material moves outward.

development_waves.label: Reader lenses
development_waves.meaning: A definitive center reader and cross-cutting lenses inspect the center without creating new knowledge owners.

development_waves.label: Living project
development_waves.meaning: Organism, Spirit/relation, Memory/history and Culture/formation become coordinated center-adjacent metabolisms.

development_waves.label: Whole-project lifecycle
development_waves.meaning: Center pairings, Shadow, Garden, Repair, Revision, Fruit and local centers turn the House into a self-correcting lifecycle.

development_waves.label: Symbol depth & inhabitation
development_waves.meaning: Deep definitions and symbol-family research culminate in an inhabited House where grammar serves concrete society rather than replacing it.

development_waves.label: Purpose & rare-value discovery
development_waves.meaning: Purpose, rare-value criteria and commit embodiment convert structural accumulation into a discovery programme.

development_waves.label: Concrete revelations
development_waves.meaning: Cross-domain syntheses gain evidence maturity classes, tests and disconfirming routes.

development_waves.label: Entity dossier crystallization
development_waves.meaning: The first real-world dossiers test project operators against source-grounded entities without replacing source identity.

development_waves.label: Foundation genealogy & Below intelligence
development_waves.meaning: Foundation becomes multi-clock generative memory with reproduction and inheritance, while Below becomes an evidence-aware intelligence/shadow platform feeding Forge review.

development_waves.label: Public homepage convergence
development_waves.meaning: The public doorway now expresses one hierarchy—Potato → House → Rooms → Views—while the five gateways remain entrances rather than rival ontology.

development_waves.label: Shared formal grammar
development_waves.meaning: The 11D thesis yields a reusable project-wide formal grammar: typed dimensions, Door/Axis/Spiral/Eye objects, morphism contracts, correspondence maturity and epistemic status are integrated across House, Axis, Body, Research and Science.

development_waves.label: Life & Body discoverability convergence
development_waves.meaning: Life & Body holdings, dossiers and the unified atlas finder converge anatomical depth, symbolic comparison and machine discovery behind one governed reader.

development_waves.label: Live nested Room discovery
development_waves.meaning: Nested Rooms now render their live holdings and routes, with regression gating so newly integrated knowledge remains discoverable rather than becoming hidden backend depth.

development_waves.label: Stale branch salvage governance
development_waves.meaning: Old PR/branch status is separated from real backlog; heavily stale branches are audited file-by-file and unique value is salvaged into current canonical owners rather than merged wholesale.

core_pairings.meaning: The Potato is what the project means; Axis is how the map stays oriented.
Door handles passage; Spirit handles living continuity.
Cross O marks their simultaneous legibility inside Door.
A successful cycle returns Fruit into future Seed.
Depth and height are organism positions, not value rankings.
Tree branches one/few into many; Mountain compresses many toward coordinated perspective.
Repair/Forge can turn residue toward Soil and future growth.
Visibility and integration are not the same as moral light/dark.
Wheel coordinates parts; Path sequences practice; Ring repeats without net displacement; Spiral changes state/level.
Contextualized history can become Soil; decontextualized recurrence can become Strife.
Research is incomplete until reviewed work produces usable consequence.

core_pairings.relation: potential → durable generative platform → living differentiated system
core_pairings.meaning: Seed becomes Foundation only when a repeatable reference/platform exists; House is what later grows and differentiates on that platform.

core_pairings.relation: hidden/buried signal → evidence-aware transformation → public/operational knowledge
core_pairings.meaning: Below gathers provenance and difficult-to-see systems; Forge tests raw intelligence before anything returns upward. Lower position is not moral guilt.

shared_tests.question: Did a real state/context/capability transition occur?
What changed this recurrence besides elapsed time?
What changed downstream, and how is quality assessed in its domain?
Does the system increase independent future capacity, correction and generativity?
What became repeatable here, how is continuity reproduced, and what change would constitute refoundation rather than ordinary revision?
What is known, how is it known, what visibility/legal status applies, what counterevidence exists, and is the claim ready to rise from raw intelligence into public knowledge?

room_pairings.contribution: Defines who and what the project says its central roles are before theology, comparison or biography elaborates them.
focus: dated changes to canonical identity language

room_pairings.contribution: Explains the theological meaning of the nucleus and tests whether God/Father/Son/Spirit language remains internally coherent and externally bounded.
Turns the center into a navigable grammar of fields, thresholds, organisms, terrains, regimes and routes.
focus: functional distinctions between planes terrains regimes organisms and routes

room_pairings.contribution: Converts the project from description into conduct, cultivation, repair, responsibility and repeatable practice.
Keeps every synthesis traceable to sources, source type, lineage and evidential limits.
focus: routes from synthesis back to artifacts

room_pairings.contribution: Recovers buried project material and turns forgotten residue into contextualized memory rather than mythology-by-reconstruction.
Pins claims to what was actually said, shown or published and when.
Provides occurrence order and date precision so change through time is not flattened into final canon.
Shows how meanings and identities actually developed rather than backdating mature structures.
Separates prior wording, event timing, claimed fulfillment and retrospective interpretation.
Supplies historically and textually grounded biblical/Christian context before project comparison.
Provides structured motif comparison while preserving the independence of source traditions.
Handles historically sourced symbolic geometry and later esoteric reception without letting symbolism substitute for provenance.
Keeps Buddhism, Daoism and other traditions on their own terms before they become project mirrors.
Makes exact what can be exact: geometry, topology, projection, recurrence and mathematical constraints.
Keeps physical/cosmological claims distinct from symbolic cosmology and supplies empirical constraints where relevant.
Formalizes feedback, capture, resilience, flow and transformation across biological, cultural and institutional systems.
Decides what a candidate would have to predict, survive or fail before promotion.
Provides the literal organism that grounds the project's biological metaphors and prevents symbolic drift.
Owns evidence-graded brain anatomy and physiology used by body comparisons.
Shows embodiment as integrated multi-system physiology rather than a brain-only model.
Provides an explicit firewalled crosswalk between body structures and project symbols.
Tests how public power, institutions and governance arrangements affect agency, correction and collective capacity.
Supplies procedural boundaries, rights, accountability and legitimate transition rules.
Tracks whether economic flows produce durable capacity, dependency, extraction or resilience.
Maps the material and digital capacity that lets world systems actually function and survive shocks.
Anchors abstract programmes and histories in real territories, boundaries and country contexts.
Explains how platform architecture changes visibility, persistence, incentives and social memory.
Analyzes how group identity becomes durable and when intensity becomes coercive capture rather than healthy culture.
Tracks how attention, repetition, forgetting, correction and transmission shape collective memory.
Turns project material into authored long-form expression while preserving the distinction between art, memory and canon.
Carries project meaning through rhythm, voice, repetition and performance as creative Fruit.
Makes relational architecture visible through authored composition without turning depiction into proof.
Lets readers interact with project rules and consequences rather than only read about them.
focus: playful tests of rules and routes

room_pairings.contribution: Owns unresolved architecture work before it is promoted into the constitutional House registries.
Holds uncertainty explicitly so unresolved ideas do not leak into canon by repetition.
Turns open questions into prototypes, explicit models and testable candidate structures.
Coordinates multi-Room research into staged workstreams with sources, owners, promotion gates and outputs.

fullness_rule: A Room is considered compositionally full when it has a clear owner/boundary, substantive holdings, a center contribution, at least one inward/outward handoff, relevant tests/lenses where appropriate, and a public or archive route for its mature material.

scoped_centers.rule: The Potato of Life remains the single semantic center and Axis the global navigation centerline. Local centers are scoped replicas/orientation points inside a Room, page, city/body/temple comparison or workflow; they must declare scope and parent center.
scoped_centers.research_context: Comparative religion records repeated/replicated center and axis imagery in houses, temples, cities, bodies and objects; multiple sacred centers can coexist within a cosmology. The project uses this only as comparative support for scoped navigation.
scoped_centers.boundary: A local center organizes a bounded context; it does not become a rival theological source, global Axis or proof that all traditions share one center.

depth_program.stop_rule: Population, instrumentation, longitudinal cases, salvage reconciliation and pruning now have priority over another broad ontology wave.

completed_p1.result: Shadow formalized as cross-plane integration/visibility overlay with positive-shadow, projection and institutional/model variants.
Eye, pyramid, 1776 and Jachin/Boaz separated into dated origin/adoption/rendering/reception genealogies.
Yggdrasil, Duat, Meru and Bardo retained as deep exemplars because each teaches a unique structural function.

completed_p2.result: Garden now has operational conditions for boundaries, circulation, diversity, feedback, participation, meaningful exit and future Seed.
Canon change now preserves prior states and defines typed revision/propagation.
Works can be evaluated as Fruit with source Rooms, intended effects, externalities, reception and future Seed.
Scoped centers now have a standard interface and mandatory parent/exit/handoff relations.
Repair now has a staged protocol from stabilization/evidence through responsibility, correction, observation, incorporation and release.
Tree of Knowledge now routes through provenance, discernment, choice and consequence before Life/Strife branching.

completed_p3.result: All mature Room dossiers carry scoped local-center interfaces and explicit handoffs.
Real source-grounded trust-infrastructure cases now exercise the entity dossier contract.
Foundation records now span multiple domains and clocks; wave 002 adds reproduction and living genealogy.
Below is populated with evidence-typed intelligence, organized-crime, exploitation, illicit-market, extremist, high-control, digital-underground and casework desks.
Homepage expresses the canonical project spine and demotes gateways to reader entrances.
The first four real entity cases now expose operating scale, key dependencies, reproduction/correction mechanisms, visibility/access limits and source-backed longitudinal indicators.
Life/Strife/Repair/Return now have mechanism contrasts and concrete evidence-aware route cases with falsifiers and World-return measures.

All 38 current Foundations now carry project-native death/life Seed states, concrete Door crossings, historical clocks, physical/institutional places, rise/fall/refoundation and reproduction boundaries.

Foundation population expanded from 38 to 52 with religious, mutual-aid, humanitarian, civil-rights, environmental, cultural and open-technology lineages, each carrying current status and House/Axis placement.

Eight concrete Works now declare source Rooms, center nodes, Fruit types, intended effects, evidence boundaries, observed/unknown reception, risks, future Seed and revision state; unknown reception remains explicitly unmeasured.
The shared dimension/operator/correspondence grammar is now CI-gated across House concepts/interfaces, Axis D^(P), body correspondences and the 11D science registry.

The stale Science semantic auditor was selectively salvaged: T3+ claims require empirical basis, models receive observable/falsifier/baseline/provenance diagnostics, generated fallback summaries no longer promote thin records, and portal validation consumes the semantic audit.

lifecycle_crystallization.meaning: The project now has a full operating loop from information through transformation, consequence, memory, correction and renewed capacity.

materialization_crystallization.status: crystallized through sequence 283 with open population work
materialization_crystallization.rule: A commit is not finished because files exist. It is crystallized only when ownership, usable population/artifact, interfaces, evidence boundaries, reader/archive expression and validation/revision are explicit.

generative_crystallization.meaning: The Foundation work closes a second lifecycle beside the knowledge lifecycle: possibility becomes a durable reference/platform, reproduces through rules and practices, differentiates, produces consequences, enters memory and can be refounded or returned.
generative_crystallization.boundary: This is a cross-domain process grammar, not a claim that organisms, religions, companies, states and harmful networks are morally or historically identical.

homepage_projection.rule: Home is a compact living projection of canonical owners. It may surface state, cases and routes, but it must not become a parallel ontology, evidence store or master registry.

sections.purpose: Teach the ontological type of major elements before symbolic interpretation: whole, coordinate, standing plane, terrain/regime, organism, threshold/process/route and inhabitant.
Expose the knowledge lifecycle and generative lifecycle as the two main operating cycles.
Show current governed project depth using counts from canonical registries.
Surface a small number of source-grounded entity cases and one longitudinal observation each.
Show what Foundation, Below→Forge, evidence/revision and Fruit/Works actually do.
Retain the five broad public gateways as reader entrances, not ontology.
Route to Axis, Research Lab, Timeline, Works, History and Sources.
Teach route families as evidence-aware state-transition hypotheses using mechanism contrasts and concrete cases with falsifiers.
Teach recurring Foundation trajectories from the full population: pressure → Door → reproduction → continuity → World return.
Make selected Foundations tangible as Door/date/place + House location + Today snapshot, with genealogy secondary.

anti_drift: Do not duplicate full dossiers on Home.
Do not present project operators as factual identities of real entities.
Do not collapse allegation, secrecy, classification or restricted access into guilt.
Do not hard-code counts when a canonical registry can supply them at runtime.
Every Home section must hand the reader to a canonical owner or mature reader surface.

teaching_sequence.label: Whole
teaching_sequence.lesson: Start with the whole. The Potato of Life coordinates the project but is not identical with every symbol, Room, tradition or claim.
teaching_sequence.question: What contains the relation without erasing its parts?

teaching_sequence.label: Coordinates
teaching_sequence.lesson: Axis, Plane and Cross orient the map. They are coordinates, not places, moral ranks or organisms.
teaching_sequence.question: Where am I looking from, and along which direction?

teaching_sequence.label: Three planes
teaching_sequence.lesson: Heaven, World and Below are standing reader platforms. They change emphasis without changing who owns the underlying knowledge.
teaching_sequence.question: Which aspect becomes visible from this reader plane?

teaching_sequence.label: Terrain & regime
teaching_sequence.lesson: Mountain, Garden, Swamp and Shadow describe integration landscapes, growth conditions or visibility problems. They are not synonyms for the three planes.
teaching_sequence.question: What kind of environment, boundary or visibility condition is operating?

teaching_sequence.label: Living systems
teaching_sequence.lesson: Roots and Trees describe memory, branching, reproduction and consequence. Knowledge can feed Life or Strife depending on what the system reproduces.
teaching_sequence.question: What is being rooted, reproduced, branched or pruned?

teaching_sequence.label: Thresholds & processes
teaching_sequence.lesson: Door changes state, Eye perceives/evaluates, Forge transforms under pressure, and Spiral/Ladder describe trajectories. Each does a different job.
teaching_sequence.question: What operation is actually changing the relation?

teaching_sequence.label: Inhabitants
teaching_sequence.lesson: Real people, institutions, texts, traditions, organisms and events inhabit the House. The symbolic grammar helps ask questions about them but never replaces their factual identity.
teaching_sequence.question: What real thing is being studied, with what evidence and at what scale?

axis_teaching.invariant: Axis is the global orientation line, not the Tree, Ladder, Mountain or a truth hierarchy.

three_planes.label: Heaven
three_planes.emphasis: integration, canopy, transmission, Garden/Fruit and accountable return

three_planes.label: World
three_planes.emphasis: embodiment, evidence, institutions, choice and observable consequence

three_planes.label: Below
three_planes.emphasis: provenance, buried context, roots, intelligence, restricted information and repair entry

axis_teaching.movement_rule: Up/down direction alone does not determine value. Rooting descent and fruitful return can be generative; upward motion without Fruit/return is not sufficient evidence of Life.

route_instrumentation.rule: Life, Strife, Repair and Return are route hypotheses over changing relations, not identities or moral labels for subjects.

foundation_seed_genealogy.rule: Every Foundation may have multiple clocks and places. Model the death-side/predecessor state, Door crossing, life-side reproducible state, rise, fall/return and refoundation separately.
invariants: Seed of Death and Seed of Life are transition states, not moral labels for whole traditions or institutions.
Place precision must match evidence: building/site, city, region, country, distributed network or virtual context.
A Foundation is demonstrated by reproduction beyond the originating person/event.
Fall may mean closure, supersession, merger, diaspora, dormancy or refoundation; it need not mean annihilation.
Refoundation is a second Door crossing that preserves some residue while changing the operating platform.

expansion_wave_003.rule: Plot stages independently: root/substrate, Door, sprout, branching and return. Do not assign a whole Foundation one moral altitude.

foundation_landscape.purpose: Compare the 52 Foundations by pressure, Door, reproduction, continuity and return without replacing their domain records or genealogies.
foundation_landscape.rule: Use archetypes as navigation and comparison. Preserve distributed/gradual formations when no single Door fits.

foundation_rooms.model: Foundation = tangible Room/blob. Origin Door, House location and Today are primary; Seed genealogy is secondary technical depth.

coordinates.today: dated continuity + current form + typed reach measures

today_snapshot.rule: Current measurements are typed, dated and source-backed. Virtual/distributed origins are valid Earth geometries and must not be forced into point pins.

first_reproduction.rule: Founding is not proof of reproduction. Record the earliest recovered successor/branch/operation/implementation after the Door and preserve uncertainty about whether it is historically first.

foundation_rooms.population_rule: Populate Origin, first reproduction and Today independently. A Room may be strong in one dimension and incomplete in another; gaps remain visible research targets.

maintenance.research_queue: Generated per Room from missing checkpoint evidence.
maintenance.door_history: Preserve later legal, operational, refoundation and supersession Doors behind the primary reader Door.
maintenance.rule: No completeness score. A Room can be strong in geography and weak in Today, or vice versa.
